description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'AcknowledgementRequestDuplicateCorrelationIdException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. The exception is thrown when a duplicate 'correlation-id' is detected in acknowledgement requests, indicating a violation of message uniqueness. It includes mechanisms for construction, JSON deserialization, and header management, and specifies error codes and templates for messaging.
